target_behavior_plan: The revised reward adds a small, event-gated touchdown_phase_bonus (10) when both legs contact and near pad (|x|<0.1, y<0.2) with low vertical speed (|vy|<0.1). This directly addresses the Phase 3 bottleneck: the policy currently reaches the ground with both legs contacting (60% both_leg_contact_rate) but fails to stabilize on the pad (0% stable_touchdown_rate, 0% near_pad_rate). The touchdown_phase_bonus provides a stepping stone between the leg_contact_bonus (10) and the success_bonus (100), encouraging the policy to not only contact the ground with both legs but also to be near the pad with low vertical speed. The bonus is event-gated (one-shot) to prevent farming. The scale is 10 (matching the leg_contact_bonus) to provide a clear stepping stone without causing the out_of_bounds behavior seen in iter_002 (where a near_pad_bonus of 5 combined with success_bonus increase to 200 caused out_of_bounds). All other components remain unchanged from iter_006. The expected outcome is that the policy will learn to stabilize on the pad, increasing success_like_terminal_rate from 0.4 to >=0.6 and decreasing unsafe_terminal_rate from 0.6 to <=0.3.
action_coverage_plan: Action coverage is already 100%. No changes needed. The revised reward should maintain or increase main engine usage for controlled descent and landing, while encouraging more precise use of orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) to stabilize the lander on the pad.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (high altitude): shaping_reward encourages descending toward pad, fuel_penalty (-0.05) discourages excessive main engine use. Phase 2 (low altitude): shaping_reward continues, fuel_penalty continues at reduced rate, vertical_speed_penalty discourages hard landings. Phase 3 (touchdown): leg_contact_bonus (10) rewards first both-leg contact, touchdown_phase_bonus (10) rewards being near pad with both legs contacting and low vertical speed, success_bonus (100) rewards full success. The touchdown_phase_bonus bridges the gap between Phase 2 and Phase 3, encouraging the policy to stabilize on the pad rather than crashing with high lateral velocity or angle.
payment_mode_plan: success_bonus is sparse (one-shot at terminal success). touchdown_phase_bonus is event-gated (one-shot when both legs contact and near pad with low vertical speed, using a flag to prevent repeatability). leg_contact_bonus is already one-shot. shaping_reward is progress-delta (not repeatable in the same sense). fuel_penalty is dense per-step penalty. orientation_penalty is dense per-step penalty. vertical_speed_penalty is dense but conditional. crash_penalty is sparse at termination. All positive terms are either sparse, event-gated, or progress-delta. No repeatable positive terms without success.
